summary_1line: Utanka reaches the Naga realm with Indra’s aid, invokes the fire god to force the Nagas to return the stolen earrings, and completes his guru’s task.

image_candidates.scene_text: Utanka furiously digs the earth with his staff for days until Indra’s thunderbolt splits the ground open into a path to the Naga realm.
In the jeweled underground world, a blazing black horse with a white tail reveals himself as the fire god and speaks to the astonished Utanka.
Thick smoke pours from the fiery steed and engulfs the golden palaces of the Nagas, driving the serpent kings out in panic to return the earrings.
